title: Staggering in California before the stroke
summary: Marge recalls that on a trip to Berkeley a friend noticed Zutty staggering as he walked, probably the stroke coming on.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: I used to hear it every night. I used to hear it and that was one reason I didn't go in that darn place. That guy was playing like...

And you know what, it must have been coming on when we were out in California out in Berkeley for the concert. We went to California to stay with our friend who has a home up in Sunset part of the strip. A beautiful home. All glass, you can look all over California. Actually it was (unintelligible).

But his swimming pool was in front of his living room and he and I were sitting in the room talking. Zutty was out in the sunshine walking around. And he said to me, Jackio he said to me, he said, Marge I don't like the way Zutty is walking. He said, he kind of staggers when he walks. And he said is there anything wrong? I said no, everything's fine.
It was coming on me then.
It was coming on him, and Jackio said, well Marge, he's not walking right.
